attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own post, stated as fact in his voice.

semantics.note: Present-tense factual claim about Agentforce annualized revenue against Salesforce quarterly revenue. 'Small relative to' paraphrases 'only', which is commentary. The proposition leaves out the ~$66M monthly figure, but the contract covers it.

contract.note: It uses the latest quarter reported before the May 26 post (FY26 Q4; FY27 Q1 came out May 27). Reading 'annualized revenue' as reported ARR and the monthly figure as simple arithmetic is the ordinary reading. Using the latest quarter for '$11B or more a quarter' is a fair plain reading.

evidence.note: Salesforce's FY26 Q4 release (Feb 25, 2026, before the post) reports Agentforce ARR of $800M, kept separate from the combined $2.9B Agentforce+Data 360 ARR, and Q4 revenue of $11.2B. 800/12 ≈ $66.7M. This is a company disclosure.
Earnings-call transcript confirms Q4 revenue of $11.2B. This is the quarterly-revenue part of the support condition, so it counts as evidence of the outcome, not just context.

reviews.rationale: Salesforce's own disclosures, available before the post, report $800M Agentforce ARR and $11.2B quarterly revenue. The monthly equivalent (~$66.7M) matches 'around $66 million'. Every numeric element meets the support condition. The 'kayfabe' remark is commentary and is not scored.
